text:
maria: Seeing a ~3x p50 increase on pool batch-s around 02:48 UTC, started at ~1842105400. Anyone else?
ashwin: Pulling traces now — any recent deploys or config changes?
maria: no code deploys, but prefetch-governor config bumped to v2.3 yesterday (smaller throttles).
deploy-bot: Deployment completed: prefetch-governor v2.3 -> staged 02:45 UTC
devon: I can repro in the flamegraphs — kernel selection flips to fallback_generic under pressure.
ashwin: flip from matmul_v2 -> fallback_generic? matmul_v2 should still be used for these shapes.
ciara: KV cache metrics show heavy prefetch churn during the window, eviction rate spiked ~6x.
maria: also saw streaming ack delays on the tool-caller queue, looks like backpressure delaying KV population.
devon: profiler snippet (quick):
```text
kernel_select: matmul_v2(98%) -> fallback_generic(87%) in 00:02
kv_prefetch: issued=3400, evicted=2100, hit_rate=0.28
batching: avg_batch=6 -> 1.8 during spike
```
ashwin: low effective batch explains throughput drop. hypothesis: prefetch churn causes hot KV evictions -> cache misses -> extra compute -> memory pressure -> kernel fallback.
ciara: the new prefetch governor was aggressive on long prompt tails; it prefetches 8 next KV blocks for streaming responses, which ends up evicting active entries when prompts are long.
maria: prompt length histogram shows heavy tail (6k-12k tokens) coming from a single tenant in that interval.
devon: logs indicate tenant=acme-ux issued many long streaming requests in parallel.
maria: @devon can you throttle acme-ux prefetch and flip them to conservative mode as a short-term mitigation?
devon: on it — will start a canary rollback of prefetch-governor and set conservative prefetch limit=2 for acme-ux.
sre-oncall: Opening incident ticket INF-2024-279 to track mitigation and postmortem.
deploy-bot: Started rollback: prefetch-governor v2.2 -> in progress
ciara: Recommend adding a kernel-selection guard: prefer matmul_v2 for seq_len <= 12k to avoid oscillation when memory pressure is transient. Also instrument prefetch-eviction-rate as an observable.
ashwin: Agree — add eviction-rate to per-route dashboards and an alert when >3x baseline.
maria: rollback is already showing p50 trending back to baseline, monitoring.
maria: p50 back to normal ~3m after rollback :thumbsup:
devon: Created PR with kernel guard and dashboard metrics (PR: rwd/infra#4521).
sre-oncall: INF-2024-279 updated: mitigations, owner @devon, follow-ups assigned.
maria: Thanks all. Follow-ups: (1) short-term tenant throttles & quotas for >5k token streaming queries, (2) adjust prefetch governor tests, (3) postmortem + eval harness for long-prompt synthetic workload.
ciara: I'll draft the synthetic eval and run prefetch policy sims.
maria: closing thread after postmortem attached.
